'''Open Tibia Server Directory''' is an independent research wiki article covering https://opentibiaservers.com/directory on [[OpenTibiaServers.com]].

== Abstract ==
Research dossier for the live Open Tibia server directory used to compare rates, population, uptime, and world types.
